title: AssuranceRequirement
description: The minimum authentication assurance a risk-sensitive operation demands before it may proceed (ADR-0015 §37-39 'Step-Up Authentication', §181). A caller's AuthenticationAssurance (authentication-assurance.schema.json) satisfies this requirement when its acr is at least minimum_acr, at least one of its amr entries is in accepted_methods, and -- when set -- its authenticated_at/step_up_at is no older than max_authentication_age_seconds.

minimum_acr.description: The lowest OIDC acr value this operation will accept.

accepted_methods.description: OIDC amr values this operation will accept.

max_authentication_age_seconds.description: Maximum age of the qualifying authentication (authenticated_at, or step_up_at when set) this operation will accept, in seconds. Absent means no freshness bound beyond acr/amr.

phishing_resistant_required.description: Whether at least one accepted method must be phishing-resistant (e.g. WebAuthn/passkey), independent of which specific amr values are listed.
